notes.title: Version 1.11
notes.content:
Fixes:

- Bug fix for the Duck Hunt achievement that was preventing the player from progressing and unlocking the achievement.

- Bug fix on the map that was not displaying items after the save was loaded.

- Bug fix for items not disappearing when picked up.

notes.title: New features to enhance gameplay
notes.content:
[h1][b]Add and corrections:[/b][/h1]

- Addition of a map with information about important items and locations.
- Introduction of an inventory system to provide information about collected items.
- implementation of objectives that must be completed to progress in the game.
- Randomization of key items to add variety and challenge.
- Introduction of difficulty levels including easy, medium, and hard.
- Expansion of interactions with various objects to display descriptive texts.
- Inclusion of Steam achievements for players to unlock.
- Rebalancing of the difficulty of the pursuer to enhance player experience.
- Revision of texts to ensure clarity and consistency.
- Correction of minor bugs.
